name: Cone Weave Walk

instructions.description: Set several markers or visual targets in a line with space between them.
Walk forward and gently weave around each marker using controlled direction changes.
Keep your posture tall and your steps deliberate as you turn.
Complete the path, then repeat if planned.

performanceMetrics.notes: Measure the total weaving path length.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Remove direction changes to make the task easier.

commentsNotes: Turn with small steps rather than twisting suddenly.
